¶ 109  τοῖσι δὲ καὶ μετέειπε βοὴν ἀγαθὸς Διομήδης·

Where a whole unit of yours has the same Greek as a published Iliad unit, its `l` and `i` must be identical to the published ones (the validator enforces it).
